ideas.title: Following the Money in Childcare Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the financial trail of childcare fraud, including the $4M daycare with no kids and a misspelled sign
questions: How did the $4M daycare receive funding?
What oversight mechanisms failed to detect the fraud?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover a larger pattern of fraud and abuse in the childcare system, and highlight the need for increased oversight and accountability.
